meta.name: Tactica Universalis Design Style
meta.description: Dual-layer style guide: referenceStyle is the aspirational pitch-deck mood board; inGameTokens documents the shipped UI as implemented in Presentation scripts.

visualPilotQueue.note: Phase G: true frosted glass Color.clear + UiFrostedGlassHost blur; rounded large frames; button aspect pill/round. Atmosphere under UI. QuickMatch excluded.

colors: Vibrant Electric Blue (#0033FF - approximate, used for glow effects)
background.description: A dark, almost black navy blue background illuminated by large, soft, radial gradients of vibrant electric blue, often positioned at the bottom, top, or corners to create depth and a 'glowing' effect.

colorPalette.accentText: Pale Blue/Ice Blue (#D0E5E9 - approximate, used for primary headings like 'INVESTOR' or 'COMPANY')
colorPalette.secondaryText: Light Gray (#E0E0E0 - approximate, used for body copy)

glassPanels.border: Translucent White (Higher opacity than background, e.g., rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2))
glassPanels.shadow: Subtle dark drop shadow to lift panels off the background

colorPalette.solidShapes: White (#FFFFFF, used for solid pill shapes or numbered cards)

primaryHeading.fontFamily: Sans-serif (Geometric, bold, e.g., Montserrat or similar)
primaryHeading.color: Pale Blue (first word/line) and White (second word/line) mixed
primaryHeading.size: Very large, dominant on the slide

secondaryHeading.size: Medium-large, used for panel titles (e.g., 'About Us')

numbers.color: White (on glass) or Black/Dark Blue (on white cards)

glassmorphismPanels.usage: Primary container for text blocks, lists, and icons. Varying sizes depending on content.

solidCards.borderRadius: Rounded corners, often with one distinct 'folded' or colored corner accent (e.g., top right corner in blue on Business Model slide)
solidCards.usage: Used for distinct, numbered steps or key points to contrast with glass panels.

pillShapes.usage: Used for tags, categories, or short lists (e.g., 'PROFESSIONAL', 'MODERN' on title slide).

icons.usage: Used inside glass panels to illustrate concepts visually. Often placed in their own smaller square glass container or aligned with lists.

buttonsControls.style: Small circular elements with arrows or 'x' marks, embedded within glass panels.
buttonsControls.usage: Decorative or suggestive of interactivity. Not the same as in-game career CTA buttons.

layoutPrinciples.spacing: Generous padding within panels and significant whitespace between elements. Layouts are uncluttered.
layoutPrinciples.alignment: Predominantly left-aligned for text within panels. Titles are often top-left. Some elements (like tags on the title slide) are center-aligned.
layoutPrinciples.hierarchy: Clear visual hierarchy established through massive typography for slide titles, followed by panel headers, then body text. Numbers are used to guide reading order on list slides.
layoutPrinciples.grid: Implied flexible grid system. Layouts vary from single large panels to split 50/50 layouts, to rows of multiple cards or lists.

buttonPolicy.source: AGENTS.md career button label height and width rules
buttonPolicy.labelHeightFill: 0.9 (90% of button face, 5% inset each edge)
buttonPolicy.bestFit: Enable Best Fit; do not post-clamp resizeTextMaxSize or fontSize down to 12-15

width.shortCta: Do not use near full-width anchors for short labels
width.longLabels: Full width allowed for long names, full competition titles, player name buttons

chrome.rule: Dark border stays tight to button; no large empty black frame around small CTAs

glassCapsule.look: Solid white pill face + dark charcoal label; Accent or danger rim for primary/confirm; no blur
glassCapsule.panelLook: Translucent glass rounded frame + thin white border; white or near-white body text; no blur

forbiddenSymbols.rule: Do not casually use decorative brackets or book-title marks in player copy
forbiddenSymbols.examples: Avoid adding corner quotes, full-width parentheses, or title marks without user approval
forbiddenSymbols.firstPersonException: Corner quotes allowed ONLY in first-person fields such as firstPersonDescription and firstPersonOptions in historical/scripted events

copyGuidelines.forbiddenReferences: Do not put design prompts or other-game analogies into player-facing text. Example: do not write EU4-like or HOI4-like comparisons in tooltips or event copy.
copyGuidelines.abbreviations: Write full readable labels. Example: use full term for recent scores, not a one-character shorthand; use full world ranking label, not abbreviated rank slang unless industry-standard and space allows.
copyGuidelines.tone: In-universe, direct, management-sim professional. Reference deck English is for visual mood only, not player strings.

exceptions.rule: Full settings button set exempt from default career CTA label-height and width policy
Tier and placement badges keep smaller fixed badge typography
Event option buttons keep existing smaller font overrides
Fixed approx 68x72 two-line registration slot; do not apply narrow CTA width rules
High-risk UTF-8 file: never PowerShell rewrite or Cursor StrReplace; use Tools/patch_*.py with UTF-8 only

mapping.notes: Phase F/G 2026-08-21: career Bg unified to starry navy #27285C; ambient gold dimmed.

Reference deck uses vibrant electric-blue radial glow; in-game uses orange-gold Accent ambient via scattered radials over multi-layer navy gradient. Do not introduce large blue ambient fills on career shell/title.
Reference ice-blue headings vs shipped gold primary accent for CTAs and rank.

Mission tree overlay uses UIBlurBlit plus UiBackdropBlurCapture for open-time backdrop blur, rounded glass panels, and pill node rows. Club hub drawer explicitly does not adopt this glass stack; career shell and hub remain opaque purple.
Hub drawer uses opaque Panel and PanelInner. B1 light_chrome pilot applied 2026-08-20. Glass blur only via screens.club_hub.nextPilotOptions glass_pilot if user explicitly requests.
Pitch-deck frosted cards vs shipped left slide drawer with square opaque wells. Hub is information-dense management UI, not pitch-deck glass cards.
Reference ice-blue headings vs hub title and section titles using career.accentGold via Accent and AddClubHubContentTitle. Do not switch hub headers to ice-blue without deliberate reskin.
Mission-tree glass infrastructure may be reused only if user picks light_chrome or glass_pilot from screens.club_hub.nextPilotOptions. Default: no hub visual pilot.
Reference Montserrat uppercase vs shipped GenYoMin2 zh-TW titles. Consider uppercase only for Latin marketing art, not in-game zh-TW headers.
Reference decorative circular controls are not the career CreateActionButton system. Always follow buttonPolicy for interactive CTAs.
Both favor clear hierarchy and breathable layout; reference is more whitespace-heavy than dense career management panels.
Career shell remains opaque purple HUD. Glass pilots: mission_tree and scripted_event B2; club_hub stays light_chrome only unless glass_pilot is explicitly requested.
Shipped event modal uses B2 glass_pilot 2026-08-20: blur backdrop + rounded translucent card with tier-colored frames. Toast and news detail remain opaque siblings.
Do not reskin entire career shell to pitch-deck glass; information density and tab rail conflict with reference whitespace model.
B3 glow_enhance implemented 2026-08-20: dual-layer radial hub glow without blur. Schedule and side panels remain opaque.
White pill reference maps loosely to CreateActionButton rows; scripted_event keeps smaller font exception.
Visual style unchanged in Phase A. All edits must use Tools/patch_*.py UTF-8 workflow per exceptions.quickmatch_controller and AGENTS.md.
